text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Dober, it's Mejiro Dober!<n>She's taken
first! That's right, folks!<n>Mejiro Dober has claimed
victory!

text_block_list.name: Male Dober Fan
text_block_list.text:
Wh-whoa! Mejiro Dober is on a<n>totally different
level today!

text_block_list.name: Female Dober Fan
text_block_list.text: Oh, Dober... You're so radiant!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations, Mejiro Dober! That<n>was a
spectacular race!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Thank you. But I'm not satisfied with<n>just this.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
There is still a goal I want to achieve,<n>or rather, an
ideal I wish to surpass.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
An ideal, you say! Could you tell us<n>who that might
be?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
(Now is the time to make my<n>intentions loud and
clear and show<n>everyone what I can do.)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I wish to challenge Air Groove.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: And I want to do that at the Queen<n>Elizabeth II Cup!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Please watch over my performance<n>and witness
my victory as Mejiro<n>Dober!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Male Dober Fan
text_block_list.text:
Sh-she's so cool! I won't miss that<n>race for the
world!

text_block_list.name: Female Dober Fan
text_block_list.text: Dober! You're incredible!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Urgh, I think I may have laid it on a bit<n>too thick just
now... I'm starting to<n>feel embarrassed...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
You're like a broken record. You've<n>said that so
many times, it's<n>completely lost its meaning.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Hehe, I'm just joking. Gullible<n>much?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Hehe, I'm just joking! I appreciate it.<n>Thanks.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Now we just have to prepare for the<n>big day.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Now we just have to prepare for the<n>big day.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Wait for me, Air Groove...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
The Queen Elizabeth II Cup is right<n>around the
corner!
